results.name: Every catalog piece survives strict validation with unique, bounded ports
Free cabinets and supports save without ports; moving the cabinet preserves contents, external parts and wires
Old projects round trip unchanged; equipment, positions and parameters share the project file
Unknown types, duplicate IDs, invalid terminals and duplicate reversed wires are rejected
Appending a montage remaps identities and tags together, preserves geometry and isolates contactors
Circuit retains after release and emergency stays latched until explicit rearm
N and PE remain different networks and unconnected readings are not fabricated
An explicit source short reports a fault rather than energizing the load
Variator ramps to setpoint and drives a six-terminal star motor
Soft starter ramps the motor voltage from the initial value to full voltage and cuts output on stop
Soft starter does not start with a missing supply phase
Reversing a moving drive first decelerates to zero
Drive validates missing phases, duplicated phases and output-source conflicts
Energy integrates measured active power and user tariff; dt=0 does not accumulate
Battery SOC decreases under load and remains within 0–100%
The solar example powers its load and solar charging disappears without irradiance
PLC physical inputs reach the existing program and Q output contacts feed a wired load
A microinverter requires grid, injects with solar and respects its nominal limit
The inverter reduces output under a load exceeding its modeled rating
Solver does not mutate saved parts, wires or parameters
Protections do not trip on a normal load, even after a long run
A sustained overload trips a breaker after an inverse-time delay and it rearms with OFF then ON
A short circuit through a breaker trips it at once instead of faulting the solver
The thermal relay measures motor current, opens its 95-96 contact on overload and drops the contactor
An ON-delay timer counts only while its coil is energized, then closes 15-18 and opens 15-16
A residual-current device ignores a balanced load but trips on an earth leak
A motor draws a start-up surge that decays to its running current
